fields.meta_title: Wholesale Order Form Builder for Brands | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a wholesale order form that sells in whole cases, applies price breaks by quantity, and checks each order minimum. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Wholesale Order Form That Applies Your Trade Terms
fields.hero_description: Build a wholesale order form that sells by the case, applies price breaks, and checks each retailer's order minimum.
fields.features_heading: Trade Terms the Form Applies as Retailers Type
fields.features_subheading: A wholesale order form sets what a retailer can order and at what price. This one checks every order before it reaches you.
fields.feature_1:
Quantities that come in whole cases

Set the case size for each product, such as 12 bottles or 6 jars. The quantity box then steps in whole cases, so nobody can order 30 of something you only ship in twelves.
fields.feature_2:
Price breaks shown as the retailer types

Give each product its quantity tiers. The unit price and line total update with every change, and the form says when a few more units would reach the next, cheaper tier.
fields.feature_3:
Reorders that start from the last order

A returning retailer enters an account number, and the form fills in the products from the last order. They change two quantities and submit instead of finding every item again.
fields.feature_4:
Orders sent to the warehouse and the rep

A submitted order goes to the warehouse by email as a pick list. At the same moment, the account's sales rep gets a Slack message with the retailer's name and the order total.
fields.feature_5:
Order history in a database you own

Every order is saved to a database you own, one row per product line, with no cap on how many orders arrive. Sort by retailer to find accounts that have not reordered since spring.
fields.feature_6:
The full code, exported to GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code of the form and its order database to your GitHub repository. A developer can host it on your own servers or keep building on it there.

fields.tab_content_1:
The form turns 30 bottles into 3 cases of 12

Emberlow Hot Sauce ships every bottle in a case of 12. Tamsin Achterberg types 30 bottles of the habanero sauce for Fennick Street Market, and the form offers 24 or 36 in their place. She takes 36, which is 3 full cases at $4.25 a bottle. The $153.00 order reaches the warehouse as a pick list.
fields.tab_content_2:
Marrowby Gifts is $38 short of its first minimum

Brackenfold Candle Co. asks more of a first order: $250, against $150 for a reorder. Odile Varga starts a first order for Marrowby Gifts, and at $212 the form tells her she is $38 short before she can submit. She adds 3 candles at $14 each, and the $254 order goes through.
fields.tab_content_3:
Halloway Day Spa cuts its total by $25.20 at 96 bars

Corvane Soapworks drops its price per bar twice: $6.00 under 48 bars, $5.40 from 48, and $4.80 from 96. Ines Margulies enters 90 bars for Halloway Day Spa, and the form prices them at $486.00. It also shows that 96 bars come to $460.80. She orders 96 and pays $25.20 less.
fields.tab_content_4:
Rafferty clears Kestrelvine for its first order the same day

Thistlecombe Leather only sells to approved retailers. Any inquiry expecting more than $1,000 a month goes to sales lead Rafferty Osei as a direct message in Slack. The rest wait for the weekly review. Kestrelvine Outfitters expects $1,800 a month. Rafferty approves it the same day, and the store gets the order form link.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Wholesale Order Form
fields.howto_description: Follow these 7 steps to turn your price list and trade terms into a wholesale order form that retailers can order from.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Write your trade terms as rules
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Decide who can see wholesale prices
fields.howto_step_1_des: Start from the price list retailers already use. Write down each product, its wholesale price per unit, and how many units ship in one case. A product you sell one at a time gets a case size of 1.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List every term a sales rep checks by hand today, such as a first-order minimum or the quantity where the price drops. Note any product that only ships on certain days. Each term becomes a rule the form applies before an order is sent.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose whether anyone with the link can order or only approved retailers. If approval comes first, put a short inquiry ahead of the order form that asks for the store name, its city, and its expected monthly volume.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Write one plain-English description of your price list and its rules, and say who receives each order. Emergent builds the form, its order database, and a screen that lists every order. Change any part later by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Send each order where it gets packed
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose who receives each order and how. The warehouse might want an email it can print, while a sales rep might prefer Slack. Add a reminder for any order not marked shipped within 2 days of arriving.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Place one test order in each price tier
fields.howto_step_6_des: Order the way a retailer would. Try a first order below the minimum, then one that crosses a price break, then a quantity that is not a whole case. Check each total against your price list before a real retailer sees the form.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send the link to your retailers
fields.howto_step_7_des: Email the link to your current accounts along with their account numbers, so the next reorder starts from the last one. For new stores, put the inquiry link on the wholesale page of your website.

faq_plan.q: What is a wholesale order form?
faq_plan.a: A wholesale order form is the form a retailer uses to buy stock from a brand or distributor at wholesale prices, to sell in its own store. It lists each product with its case size and unit price, and it collects the retailer's account details, the quantities, and the delivery address.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a wholesale order form?
faq_plan.a: Start with your price list, the number of units in each case, and the terms you hold retailers to, such as an order minimum. Describe all of it to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English. Emergent builds the form, the rules that check each order, and a database for the orders, and you change any of it later by prompting.

faq_plan.q: What should a wholesale order form template include?
faq_plan.a: Include the retailer's business name, account number, and delivery address, then one line per product with its item code, case size, unit price, and a quantity box. Add the order minimum and a delivery date. A wholesale order form template that leaves out case sizes means correcting quantities by phone after the order arrives.

faq_plan.q: What is the difference between a bulk order form and a wholesale order form?
faq_plan.a: A bulk order form takes one large purchase, while a wholesale order form serves retailers who buy at wholesale prices to resell and who come back to reorder. An office buying 200 lunches for one event would use a catering order form instead. Wholesale forms add what a one-off order does not need: case sizes, account numbers, and minimums.

faq_plan.q: What should a wholesale inquiry form ask a new retailer?
faq_plan.a: Ask for the store's name, its city, a link to its website or storefront, what it sells now, and the monthly order it expects. Those answers tell you whether the store fits your brand and how quickly to reply. Keep the wholesale inquiry form short, and leave the account paperwork for after you approve the store.

faq_plan.q: Can I make a free wholesale order form online?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing. You can build a free wholesale order form and share the link with retailers. Emergent forms also have no response caps.

faq_plan.q: Can a wholesale order form show a photo of each product?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if you ask for it: Emergent builds the form with a small photo beside each product line. A retailer reordering 20 items can then check scents or colors by sight instead of by item code. A photography order form works the other way around: the customer picks prints and sizes from the photos themselves.

faq_plan.q: How should a wholesale order form handle items that are out of stock?
faq_plan.a: Mark the item out of stock on the form so retailers see it before they order, or accept it as a backorder with the expected ship date beside the quantity. Ask whether a backordered item should ship on its own or wait for the rest. If your stock counts live in a tool with an API, the app Emergent builds can sync them in.

faq_plan.q: How do I keep the prices on a wholesale order form private to approved retailers?
faq_plan.a: Ask for an account number before the form shows any prices, and issue that number only when you approve a store. Anyone without one sees the inquiry form instead. A wholesale order form PDF shows its prices to anyone it is forwarded to. Change or retire a number when a store closes its account.

faq_plan.q: Can a wholesale order form handle perishable goods with set delivery days?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Wholesale order forms for perishable goods need a delivery date limited to the days your trucks run, plus an order cutoff, such as noon 2 days before delivery. Show the shelf life next to each product. Retailers can then order only what they will sell in time. For meals ordered by individual customers, a food order form is the better fit.

plan.angle: The top 10 for this term is printable PDF sheets, store plugins and a template gallery: a grid of products and blank quantity boxes that leaves the trade terms for someone to check by hand. This page shows a wholesale order form that applies those terms while the retailer fills it in: quantities in whole case packs for a hot sauce brand, an opening-order minimum for a candle maker, price breaks by quantity for a soap maker, and retailer inquiries that reach the sales lead for a leather goods brand. The FAQ covers the definition, building one, what a template should hold, bulk versus wholesale, inquiries, free options, product photos, reorders, private prices and perishable goods.
